title: GitHub - tohid4n/qwen3.8-max-local-coding: 🚀 Free unlimited local AI coding with Qwen 3.8-Max + MCP Filesystem. Step-by-step setup guide with demo.
excerpt: 🚀 Free unlimited local AI coding with Qwen 3.8-Max + MCP Filesystem. Step-by-step setup guide with demo. - tohid4n/qwen3.8-max-local-coding
content_html:
Code for free using one of the most powerful open-source AI models — no API keys, no subscriptions.

This guide shows you how to set up Qwen 3.8-Max (via Qwen Studio) with MCP (Model Context Protocol) to read, write, and edit files on your machine — turning it into a fully capable AI coding assistant.

⚠️ Important: Qwen 3.8-Max runs in the cloud through Qwen Studio. Your prompts and any file contents read via MCP are sent to Qwen's servers for processing. The MCP servers themselves (Filesystem, Fetch, etc.) run locally on your machine. Review Qwen's privacy policy before using this with sensitive or proprietary code.

🎬 Demo

✨ Why This Setup?

Feature Details
💰 Cost Free to use (no API keys or subscriptions needed)
☁️ How it works Model runs in the cloud via Qwen Studio; MCP servers run locally on your machine
♾️ Usage Free tier — subject to Qwen's usage policies and may vary
🧠 Model Qwen 3.8-Max — 2.4T parameter MoE model (~95B active), 1M context window, native multimodal
🔌 Integration MCP Filesystem — the model can read/write your local files via MCP

🛠️ Step-by-Step Setup

Step 1: Download & Install Qwen Studio

  1. Go to qwen.ai/download and download the desktop application for your operating system (available for macOS and Windows only).
  2. Install and open Qwen Studio.

Step 2: Open MCP Settings

  1. In the Qwen Studio interface, look for the Add (+) icon or the Settings (⚙️) icon.
  2. Click on it to open the settings panel.
  3. Find and click on the MCP option.

Step 3: Enable Filesystem MCP

  1. Navigate to "My MCPs" section.
  2. Locate the MCP called "Filesystem".
  3. Enable it by toggling it on.

Don't see it pre-listed?

Qwen Studio fetches MCPs at runtime, so you can add any public MCP manually via Add MCP.

📁 Filesystem (Node/npm — runs via npx)

⚠️ Requires Node.js installed — npx comes bundled with it.

Option 1: JSON Configuration

To give access to multiple specific folders, add each path as a new string in the args array (separate them with commas).

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "filesystem": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": [
        "-y",
        "@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem@latest",
        "/path/to/folder1",
        "/path/to/folder2",
        "/path/to/folder3"
      ]
    }
  }
}

Option 2: Via the Form

  1. Click Add MCP → Quick Add.
  2. Name: Enter a simple, lowercase identifier with no spaces (e.g., filesystem or my-files).
  3. Description: Optional (e.g., "Access to project files").
  4. Type: Choose STDIO (standard input/output).
  5. Command: Choose npx.
  6. Parameters: Paste the config below. To add multiple folders, separate the paths with spaces: -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem@latest /path/to/folder1 /path/to/folder2

Step 4: Start Coding!

That's it! You now have a fully functional AI coding assistant that can:

  • 📖 Read your project files and understand your codebase
  • ✏️ Write new files and create entire projects
  • 🔧 Edit existing code with context-aware modifications
  • 📁 Navigate your file system and understand project structure

💡 Tips for Best Results

  • Be specific — Tell the model exactly which files or directories to work with
  • Provide context — Mention the programming language, framework, or library you're using
  • Iterate — Start with small tasks and build up to larger ones
  • Review changes — Always review the code changes before accepting them

🤔 FAQ

Is this really free?

Yes! Qwen Studio provides free access to Qwen 3.8-Max — no API keys or subscriptions required. The model runs in the cloud on Qwen's infrastructure. Usage may be subject to Qwen's terms and fair-use policies.

What is Qwen 3.8-Max?

Qwen 3.8-Max is Alibaba's most capable open-source model, released on August 3, 2026. It's a 2.4-trillion-parameter sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model with ~95 billion active parameters per token. It supports a 1-million-token context window and native multimodal input (text, image, video). Read the official blog post for full details.

How does MCP work?

MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open standard that allows AI models to interact with external tools and data sources. The Filesystem MCP gives the model permission to read and write files on your local machine, enabling it to act as a coding assistant.

Is my code sent to the cloud?

Yes. Qwen 3.8-Max runs on Qwen's cloud servers — your prompts and any file contents read by the MCP Filesystem are sent to Qwen's servers for inference. The MCP servers themselves run locally on your machine, but the model processing happens in the cloud. Avoid using this with sensitive, proprietary, or confidential code unless you've reviewed and accepted Qwen's privacy policy.

What kind of coding tasks can it handle?

Pretty much anything — writing new code, debugging, refactoring, explaining code, creating project structures, writing tests, and more. Qwen 3.8-Max excels at coding, professional "cowork" tasks, and long-horizon agentic workflows.

content_html_zh:
使用最强大的开源 AI 模型之一免费编码 — 无需 API 密钥，无需订阅。

本指南向您展示如何使用 MCP（模型上下文协议）设置 Qwen 3.8-Max（通过 Qwen Studio）来读取、写入和编辑计算机上的文件 - 将其变成功能齐全的 AI 编码助手。

⚠️重要提示：Qwen 3.8-Max 通过 Qwen Studio 在云端运行。 您的提示和通过 MCP 读取的任何文件内容都会发送到 Qwen 的服务器进行处理。 MCP 服务器本身（文件系统、Fetch 等）在您的计算机上本地运行。 在将其用于敏感或专有代码之前，请先查看 Qwen 的隐私政策。

🎬 Demo

✨ 为什么要这样设置？

特征 细节
💰 Cost 免费使用（无需 API 密钥或订阅）
☁️ 它是如何运作的 模型通过Qwen Studio在云端运行； MCP 服务器在您的计算机上本地运行
♾️ Usage 免费套餐 - 遵守 Qwen 的使用政策，并且可能会有所不同
🧠 Model Qwen 3.8-Max — 2.4T 参数 MoE 模型（~95B 活动），1M 上下文窗口，原生多模态
🔌 整合 MCP 文件系统 — 该模型可以通过 MCP 读取/写入本地文件

🛠️ 分步设置

第1步：下载并安装Qwen Studio

  1. 转至 qwen.ai/download 并下载适合您操作系统的桌面应用程序（仅适用于 macOS 和 Windows）。
  2. 安装并打开 Qwen Studio。

第 2 步：打开 MCP 设置

  1. 在 Qwen Studio 界面中，查找添加 (+) 图标或设置 (⚙️) 图标。
  2. 单击它打开设置面板。
  3. 找到并单击 MCP 选项。

步骤 3：启用文件系统 MCP

  1. 导航至“我的 MCP”部分。
  2. 找到名为“文件系统”的 MCP。
  3. 通过打开它来启用它。

没有看到它已预先列出？

Qwen Studio 在运行时获取 MCP，因此您可以通过“添加 MCP”手动添加任何公共 MCP。

📁 文件系统（Node/npm — 通过 npx 运行）

⚠️ 需要安装 Node.js — npx 与其捆绑在一起。

选项 1：JSON 配置

要授予对多个特定文件夹的访问权限，请将每个路径作为新字符串添加到 args 数组中（用逗号分隔）。

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "filesystem": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": [
        "-y",
        "@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem@latest",
        "/path/to/folder1",
        "/path/to/folder2",
        "/path/to/folder3"
      ]
    }
  }
}

选项 2：通过表格

  1. 单击添加 MCP → 快速添加。
  2. 名称：输入一个简单的小写标识符，不带空格（例如，文件系统或我的文件）。
  3. 描述：可选（例如，“访问项目文件”）。
  4. 类型：选择STDIO（标准输入/输出）。
  5. 命令：选择 npx。
  6. 参数：粘贴下面的配置。 要添加多个文件夹，请用空格分隔路径： -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem@latest /path/to/folder1 /path/to/folder2

第四步：开始编码！

就是这样！ 您现在拥有一个功能齐全的 AI 编码助手，它可以：

  • 📖 阅读您的项目文件并了解您的代码库
  • ✏️ 编写新文件并创建整个项目
  • 🔧 通过上下文感知修改来编辑现有代码
  • 📁 浏览文件系统并了解项目结构

💡获得最佳效果的技巧

  • 具体——准确告诉模型要使用哪些文件或目录
  • 提供上下文 - 提及您正在使用的编程语言、框架或库
  • 迭代——从小任务开始，逐渐扩大到更大的任务
  • 检查更改——在接受代码更改之前始终检查它们

🤔 FAQ

Is this really free?

是的！ Qwen Studio 提供对 Qwen 3.8-Max 的免费访问 - 无需 API 密钥或订阅。 该模型在 Qwen 基础设施的云端运行。 使用可能须遵守 Qwen 的条款和合理使用政策。

What is Qwen 3.8-Max?

Qwen 3.8-Max是阿里巴巴最强大的开源模型，于2026年8月3日发布。 它是一个包含 2.4 万亿参数的稀疏专家混合 (MoE) 模型，每个代币约有 950 亿个活跃参数。 它支持 100 万个令牌上下文窗口和本机多模式输入（文本、图像、视频）。 请阅读官方博客文章了解完整详细信息。

How does MCP work?

MCP（模型上下文协议）是一个开放标准，允许 AI 模型与外部工具和数据源交互。 文件系统 MCP 授予模型在本地计算机上读取和写入文件的权限，使其能够充当编码助手。

Is my code sent to the cloud?

是的。 Qwen 3.8-Max 在 Qwen 的云服务器上运行 - 您的提示和 MCP 文件系统读取的任何文件内容都会发送到 Qwen 的服务器进行推理。 MCP 服务器本身在您的计算机上本地运行，但模型处理发生在云中。 除非您已阅读并接受 Qwen 的隐私政策，否则请避免将其与敏感、专有或机密代码一起使用。

What kind of coding tasks can it handle?

几乎任何事情——编写新代码、调试、重构、解释代码、创建项目结构、编写测试等等。 Qwen 3.8-Max 擅长编码、专业“协同”任务和长期代理工作流程。
